title: Reading Drill — How a School Chose a Uniform Supplier
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: How a School Chose a Uniform Supplier
passages.body:
**A** A school compared two possible uniform suppliers by asking families about price, comfort and replacement costs. It wanted to learn what families paid across a whole year.

**B** The cheapest shirt needed replacing more frequently in a small washing trial. One reason was that the collar lost its shape quickly, even when the shirt was dried without heat.

**C** The school selected a supplier offering two fabrics in the same colour. Families could buy a lighter fabric for summer without requiring the school to adopt a second uniform design.
